summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of Plotlab graphing calculator completed. All 15 specified features pass end-to-end including initial load, dynamic variable detection, invalid input handling, add/remove function, visibility toggle, slider real-time updates, slider min/max editing, independent variable change, domain change, theme toggle, preset loading (damped oscillator), Export PNG (toast verified), reset view, and responsive layout at 1920x1080. No console/page errors observed during the run.
critical_code_review_comments: FunctionRow.jsx line 76: condition `fn.error && (focused || true)` always evaluates focused to true — the `focused` state is effectively unused dead code; consider simplifying to just `fn.error &&` or removing the focused state entirely.

GraphingCalculator.jsx uses a module-level mutable counter `nextId` that is reset in handlePickPreset; this can produce duplicate React keys if user adds a function before picking a preset that resets to a colliding id. Consider using a ref-based counter or crypto.randomUUID() for stable, collision-free keys.
varStore is never garbage-collected when variables disappear from expressions; long sessions may accumulate stale entries (memory leak risk is small but worth noting).
PlotCanvas Plotly.downloadImage will fail silently in some headless environments; the catch in handleExport correctly surfaces this via toast.error.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend smoke covered all 15 acceptance criteria via Playwright. Sliders are Radix-based and respond to keyboard ArrowRight on focused thumb (used in test 7). Plotly traces selector that worked: `g.scatterlayer .trace` for trace count, and `.js-line` for initial line presence. Toast text 'Graph exported as PNG' confirmed visible after Export PNG click. Theme toggle flips `dark` class on documentElement. No backend involved.
